blocks.html: Join in and be part Robinsons Malls' Easter Eggspedition on April 5, Easter Sunday from 10:00 am to 5pm.

Shop at Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Place Manila and enjoy the fun games and activities like Easter Egg hunting, magic show and tea &amp; cookie party slated on April 5, Easter Sunday from 10AM - 5PM.

For a minimum single receipt purchase of Php1,000.00 from March 30 - April 4, you may pre-register a child at the designated information counter and get a ticket to join the Robinsons Malls Easter Eggspedition activities.

Celebrate Easter at Robinsons Metro East, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Town Mall Los Malabon, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Summit Ridge Tagaytay, Robinsons Place Lipa and Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños and enjoy the different Easter activities plus have a chance to win exciting prizes and gift certificates from participating stores.
For more information, you may call: 397-1888 or check the Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls
